_comment: Measured off the ORIGINAL PhysX truck by PhysxReferenceTests in the Unity
project, which drives TruckController with scripted inputs and records what
it does. This is the definition of how the game drives; the deterministic
Recorded 2026-09-01 against unity-proto at the freeze of the single-player

tolerance._comment: Fractions. Yaw is the tightest because it is what a player calls steering strength; the speed a hard corner scrubs off is the loosest, because the core models tyre scrub with one coefficient and PhysX with a friction curve.
